verdant_wildbloom_surge.perspective: Low ground-level three-quarter view following the curved growth path toward the centered fan of leaves and pollen.
verdant_wildbloom_surge.background: A cool blue-grey colonnade in deep shade, opposing the warm pollen and vivid green surge while keeping the silhouette uncluttered.
verdant_wildbloom_surge.notes: No caster, creatures, giant flowers, whole forest, tornado, explosion, text-like vine patterns, or frame-filling pollen cloud.

verdant_praxis_seed_of_new_ages.subject: Praxis is a colossal but finite guardian grown around an ancient honey-gold seed core, with a broad cedar-root torso, forest-green canopy shoulders, and one massive arm forming a living wall while the other drives new roots through shattered foundations. Pale new-growth leaves crown the joints, signaling a future age rather than old decay.
verdant_praxis_seed_of_new_ages.perspective: Low dramatic three-quarter view showing Praxis from rooted base to canopy head, with the seed core and both distinct arms inside the middle 70%.
verdant_praxis_seed_of_new_ages.background: A warm ember-red sunrise over open ruins, silhouetting the dark green and cedar mass while the honey-gold core remains the focal light.
verdant_praxis_seed_of_new_ages.notes: Bulwark is the wall arm; Overwhelm is the foundation-splitting root arm. No humanoid knight armor, antler crown, weapon, world-tree scale, tiny army, or copied Rootwall Titan pose.

clock_repair_drone.subject: A palm-sized brass repair drone clings magnetically to a cracked iron beam, using two delicate tool legs to fit a copper staple while a third lens-arm projects a narrow arc-blue weld. Its flattened beetle-like chassis and spool tail make it distinct from the round hovering Assembly Drone.
clock_repair_drone.perspective: Macro side-on three-quarter view with the complete drone, cracked beam, copper staple, and short weld line centered and readable.
clock_repair_drone.background: A warm parchment-amber construction bay with soft dusty light, opposing the cool iron beam and arc-blue welding focal point.
clock_repair_drone.notes: One crawling repair drone only. No hovering body, Gear Wisp, humanoid face, swarm, giant machinery, text, or explosive sparks.

clock_blueprint_archive.subject: A compact rotating archive cylinder of tarnished copper holds dozens of rolled blank blueprints in radial brass slots, while one selected parchment sheet lifts halfway out beneath an arc-blue indexing lens. Three articulated feet keep the cabinet level on broken stone.
clock_blueprint_archive.perspective: Eye-level three-quarter product-like view with the entire archive cylinder, selected roll, lens, and three feet centered inside the frame.
clock_blueprint_archive.background: A cool charcoal-grey records room with blurred empty shelves and pale blue shadow, contrasting with the warm parchment and copper body.
clock_blueprint_archive.notes: No readable labels, diagrams, humanoid librarian, floating book, giant room-filling machine, decorative clock face, or loose paper storm.

clock_tinkers_gambit.subject: A blackened-steel tinker’s hand releases one tiny brass gear across a slanted copper game board toward two open sockets: one glowing arc blue and one dark. The gear balances briefly on its edge at the branching track, with a taut mainspring beneath the board ready to snap either way.
clock_tinkers_gambit.perspective: Tight top-down three-quarter close view centered on the rolling gear, forked mechanical track, two sockets, and visible mainspring.
clock_tinkers_gambit.background: A warm parchment-amber workbench fading into soft shadow, opposing the cool steel hand and blue active socket.
clock_tinkers_gambit.notes: Chance is mechanical uncertainty, not casino imagery. No dice, cards, coins, readable odds, text, faces, gambling table, or explosive failure.

clock_reconstructed_automaton.subject: A sturdy humanoid automaton stands with one broad forearm locked across its chest, visibly rebuilt from a polished-brass upper body, tarnished-copper replacement hip, and oiled-steel legs joined by fresh rivet lines. An arc-blue core shines steadily behind a new square protective grille.
clock_reconstructed_automaton.perspective: Low full-body three-quarter portrait with the complete mismatched automaton, guarding forearm, core grille, and both feet centered.
clock_reconstructed_automaton.background: A warm amber-lit salvage workshop of pale timber and parchment dust, separating the cool steel limbs and blue core.
clock_reconstructed_automaton.notes: Bulwark reads through the locked forearm and stable rebuilt stance. No patchwork monster, weapon, giant scale, extra arms, floating parts, or pristine symmetry.

clock_assembly_line.subject: A single diagonal workshop conveyor carries three stages of the same compact construct chassis—bare steel frame, brass-plated torso, then arc-blue core installation—beneath precisely spaced copper tool gantries. The final core has just lit, creating a clear left-to-right sequence without a crowd.
clock_assembly_line.perspective: High three-quarter view along the conveyor with all three assembly stages and the lit final core centered inside the middle 70%.
clock_assembly_line.background: A dark cool slate factory floor with soft iron shadows, making the warm brass stages and blue focal core stand out.
clock_assembly_line.notes: No humanoid workers, endless factory vista, army of finished robots, text, numbered stations, smoke plume, or chaotic overlapping machinery.

clock_mainspring_halberd.subject: A single long halberd combines an oiled-steel crescent blade with a brass shaft mechanism whose exposed cartwheel mainspring sits just below the head. The spring is half-wound and pulls two copper tension rods taut along the blade spine, while a small arc-blue release stud marks the grip.
clock_mainspring_halberd.perspective: Clean diagonal three-quarter weapon portrait showing the complete head, mainspring, shaft, and grip inside the middle 70% with generous margin.
clock_mainspring_halberd.background: A warm parchment-amber armory wall with blurred wooden racks, opposing the cool steel blade and blue release stud.
clock_mainspring_halberd.notes: No wielder, readable markings, clock numerals, gun mechanism, oversized fantasy blade, lightning discharge, extra weapons, or cropped tip.

clock_upgrade_protocol.subject: Four articulated ivory-ceramic tools converge on one worn brass construct core, replacing its dull copper ring with a larger polished-steel ring as an arc-blue pulse travels through newly aligned contacts. Removed pieces rest in one orderly row below, making the upgrade visibly planned and reversible.
clock_upgrade_protocol.perspective: Close overhead three-quarter view with the core, four tools, new ring, and ordered removed parts centered as one precise operation.
clock_upgrade_protocol.background: A warm dark-amber repair mat with subtle parchment texture, contrasting with the cool steel upgrade and blue electrical pulse.
clock_upgrade_protocol.notes: No readable blueprint, diagrams, humanoid patient, giant explosion, magical rune circle, weapon, or scattered scrap.

clock_masterwork_constructor.subject: A tall six-armed construction automaton of polished brass and oiled steel stands within a timber frame, each hand performing one distinct task: holding a beam, setting a rivet, tensioning wire, measuring a joint, steadying a brace, and guiding an arc-blue plumb light. Its narrow torso and tripod base keep the complex silhouette organized.
clock_masterwork_constructor.perspective: Low medium-full three-quarter view with all six arms, tripod base, and central plumb light readable inside the frame.
clock_masterwork_constructor.background: A cool pale-blue open sky seen through the warm timber structure, separating the brass figure without dark visual clutter.
clock_masterwork_constructor.notes: One constructor only. No spider body, weapon arms, extra workers, readable plans, city panorama, giant scale, or tangled arm overlap.

clock_cogsworth_the_grand_rebuilder.subject: Cogsworth is a massive broad-backed rebuilding construct with a dignified brass mask, iron-grey load-bearing limbs, and a cathedral-like copper repair gantry folded across the shoulders. He kneels over a shattered civic arch, lifting its keystone with one hand while four precise tool fingers rebuild the foundation beneath it; an arc-blue core glows behind a heavy protective grille.
clock_cogsworth_the_grand_rebuilder.perspective: Low dramatic three-quarter view with Cogsworth's masked head, protected core, kneeling base, keystone hand, and rebuilding hand all centered.
clock_cogsworth_the_grand_rebuilder.background: A warm coral-and-amber sunrise across pale settlement ruins, opposing the cool steel mass and arc-blue core.
clock_cogsworth_the_grand_rebuilder.notes: Bulwark is his load-bearing body, not a shield. No throne, clock face, city-sized colossus, army of drones, weapon, readable plaque, or duplicate of The Great Mechanism.

night_shadow_scout.subject: A small Nightveil scout lies flat beneath the shadow of a collapsed beam, wrapped in matte midnight-purple cloth with only a blade-silver monocular and one bone-white fingertip visible. The trailing edge of the cloak dissolves into a thin black smoke line that follows the rubble contour.
night_shadow_scout.perspective: Low close eye-level three-quarter view along the beam with the scout's compact prone silhouette, monocular, and vanishing cloak edge centered.
night_shadow_scout.background: A warm amber rebuilding street beyond the cool shadowed rubble, sharply outlining the hidden figure's silver focal detail.
night_shadow_scout.notes: Shroud is concealment through stillness. No crouching rooftop pose, bow, dagger attack, glowing eyes, multiple scouts, giant smoke cloud, or copied Veilborn Scout corner.

night_ink_viper.subject: A hand-length viper with glossy shadow-black scales swims through a shallow spill of midnight-purple ink, its narrow bone-white belly and one toxic-lime fang briefly breaking the surface. One cropped warm-brown hand jerks away at the frame edge and drops an ivory quill as the rear half of the snake dissolves into the ink.
night_ink_viper.perspective: Macro top-down three-quarter view with the entire curved viper, ink wake, pale belly edge, and single venom fang centered while the recoiling hand stays subordinate at the outer edge.
night_ink_viper.background: A warm amber parchment worktable with soft candlelight, creating maximum contrast around the black-purple snake and green focal point.
night_ink_viper.notes: Venom is one fang; Shroud is the ink merge. The single dropped quill and recoiling hand show fear without competing with the snake. No giant serpent, readable writing, venom spray, extra snakes, open mouth, or magical rune.

night_marked_for_death.subject: A plain bone-white ceramic mask hangs against a warm wall as one hair-thin blade-silver scratch crosses its lower edge and a toxic-lime droplet settles precisely at the line's endpoint. Midnight-purple shadow has begun closing around the mask from both sides, leaving the mark unavoidable but restrained.
night_marked_for_death.perspective: Tight frontal close view with the complete mask, silver scratch, green droplet, and encroaching shadow centered in a simple composition.
night_marked_for_death.background: A warm amber plaster wall lit by one off-frame lantern, opposing the cold pale mask and dark shadow.
night_marked_for_death.notes: No skull, target reticle, written name, blood, victim body, assassin hand, weapon, rune, or large green poison splash.

night_veilborn_spy.subject: A lean spy in midnight-purple shadow-silk stands inside the narrow gap between two hanging construction tarps, using a small blade-silver mirror to observe the street behind without exposing the face. Bone-white stitching outlines one shoulder before the lower body vanishes into shadow-smoke.
night_veilborn_spy.perspective: Eye-level medium-full three-quarter view with the spy, mirror, tarp gap, and complete fading silhouette centered and readable.
night_veilborn_spy.background: A warm lantern-amber work yard visible through the gap, sharply opposing the cool dark clothing and silver mirror.
night_veilborn_spy.notes: Shroud is the tarp-and-shadow concealment. No rooftop, poison, dagger attack, readable document, disguise costume, second identity, or crowd.

night_contract_kill.subject: A taut blade-silver wire snaps a single dark wooden support pin in a precise quiet cut, causing a suspended iron counterweight to begin dropping out of frame. One black-gloved hand releases the wire while a toxic-lime wax bead on the severed pin identifies the prepared contract without text.
night_contract_kill.perspective: Tight side-on three-quarter close view centered on the wire, breaking pin, releasing hand, and first movement of the counterweight.
night_contract_kill.background: A warm amber-lit warehouse beam and ochre dust haze, providing strong contrast around the cold silver mechanism and black glove.
night_contract_kill.notes: Imply the kill through engineered consequence; show no victim, corpse, blood, written contract, crossbow, giant trap, explosion, or full assassin.

night_network_operative.subject: A poised Nightveil operative crouches inside an abandoned bell tower, holding five fine blade-silver signal threads that disappear through separate cracks in the masonry toward unseen contacts. Midnight-purple clothing blends into the interior while one toxic-lime bead slides along the central thread toward the hand.
night_network_operative.perspective: High medium three-quarter view with the operative's full crouched silhouette, hand, and five clearly separated outgoing threads centered.
night_network_operative.background: A warm amber city street far below and ochre sunset through the openings, outlining the cool dark figure and silver network.
night_network_operative.notes: Shroud is the concealed tower position. No spider imagery, web covering the frame, readable signals, multiple agents, weapon attack, throne, or giant magic aura.

night_double_agent.subject: One androgynous agent stands between two doorways wearing a reversible cloak caught mid-turn: one side warm stone-grey settlement cloth, the other midnight-purple shadow-silk with a blade-silver lining. A single bone-white half-mask rotates in the figure's hand while the face remains calm and partially visible.
night_double_agent.perspective: Eye-level full-body three-quarter portrait with the single agent, both cloak faces, half-mask, and two doorways centered in a balanced composition.
night_double_agent.background: One doorway opens to warm amber lamplight and the other to cool blue-black shadow, giving each side of the cloak an opposing ground.
night_double_agent.notes: One person only, not twins or a mirror clone. No readable insignia, two faces, poison, dagger fight, split-screen line, crowd, or theatrical stage pose.

night_seraphine_whisper_queen.subject: Seraphine is an adult woman seated sideways on a plain stone council chair, her midnight-purple mantle dissolving into thin whisper-like ribbons that reach four empty positions around a circular table. A blade-silver veil frames her composed face, and one toxic-lime earring provides the only vivid accent as her raised finger stills the room.
night_seraphine_whisper_queen.perspective: Eye-level medium-full three-quarter portrait with Seraphine's face, raised finger, complete chair, and four restrained shadow ribbons centered.
night_seraphine_whisper_queen.background: A warm amber council chamber of aged ochre stone and low candles, contrasting with her cool dark silhouette.
night_seraphine_whisper_queen.notes: Shroud is the vanishing mantle. Queen is influence, not monarchy: no crown, ornate throne, swarm of faces, giant wings, weapon, seductive pose, or readable documents.

storm_static_wisp.subject: A fist-sized wisp formed from a charcoal storm-knot skitters just above a stone rail, its three cyan filament legs touching down in rapid sequence and leaving short gold-white static ticks. A single storm-silver eye-point faces the direction of travel.
storm_static_wisp.perspective: Macro low side-on three-quarter view with the complete tiny wisp, three filament legs, and short motion path centered inside the frame.
storm_static_wisp.background: A pale warm ochre rooftop at sunset, providing clean value and temperature contrast behind the dark knot and cyan electricity.
storm_static_wisp.notes: Skirmish is a quick local scuttle. No imp face, wings, humanoid child, lightning bolt, duplicate of Gust Sprite, storm panorama, or more than one wisp.

storm_galecleaver.subject: A single compact polearm built to cut wind rather than flesh: a charcoal-black haft supports two offset storm-silver crescent vanes around an open center, where a taut cyan filament vibrates between gold-white contact points. A narrow ribbon of air passes through the gap and splits into two clean trails behind the head.
storm_galecleaver.perspective: Diagonal three-quarter weapon portrait with the complete twin-vane head, vibrating filament, grip, and split air trails contained inside the middle 70%.
storm_galecleaver.background: A warm dusty coral sky above a softly blurred cliff forge, separating the cool silver-black weapon and cyan focal filament.
storm_galecleaver.notes: No wielder, readable marks, oversized axe blade, lightning explosion, tornado, extra weapons, cropped tip, or resemblance to Mainspring Halberd.

storm_chain_caller.subject: A lean storm-caller in charcoal wraps holds two small storm-silver tuning forks at different heights, drawing one cyan spark into a controlled zigzag chain between four gold-white conductor beads sewn along the sleeves. Wind pulls the fabric sideways while the caller's stance remains precise.
storm_chain_caller.perspective: Eye-level medium-full three-quarter view with the caller, both forks, four conductor beads, and complete chained spark path centered.
storm_chain_caller.background: A warm amber canyon wall under dusty orange light, opposing the cool dark figure and bright cyan electricity.
storm_chain_caller.notes: One caller only. No lightning from the sky, enemy targets, giant staff, rune circle, choir, storm vortex, or duplicate of the Chain Spark ring apparatus.

storm_lightning_lash.subject: A single flexible lash of gold-white lightning curves through the air from a small storm-silver grip, its cyan inner trace tightening into one sharp loop just before the tip snaps straight. Three evenly spaced thunder beads show the wave traveling along the energy without forming a weapon of solid metal.
storm_lightning_lash.perspective: Close side-on three-quarter action view with the grip, full looping lash, thunder beads, and straightening tip centered against negative space.
storm_lightning_lash.background: A warm muted terracotta wall and amber dust haze, maximizing contrast around the cold cyan and gold-white electrical curve.
storm_lightning_lash.notes: No wielder, victim, giant bolt, chain links, multiple lashes, explosion, text, or lightning filling the entire frame.

storm_channeler.subject: A grounded Tempest adept kneels between two iron-black lightning rods, guiding a broad cyan current from one gold-white palm through a storm-silver chest harness and into a cracked settlement battery. Thin double-traces at the elbows show rising power while the body remains calm and controlled.
storm_channeler.perspective: Low medium-full three-quarter view with the channeler, both rods, chest harness, and battery connection centered and clearly separated.
storm_channeler.background: A warm copper-orange repair shelter with ochre canvas and amber work lights, opposing the cool electrical subject.
storm_channeler.notes: Arcane Surge is increased current through a real harness. No floating mage, spellbook, sky bolt, giant aura, enemy, readable gauge, or uncontrolled electrocution.

storm_voltaic_sentinel.subject: A broad sentinel built from storm-black ceramic plates stands behind a vertical cage of three storm-silver conductors, each channeling gold-white current safely into a cyan grounding core at the waist. Its shoulders form a low thunder-ring silhouette and heavy feet clamp to the stone.
storm_voltaic_sentinel.perspective: Low frontal full-body three-quarter view with the sentinel, conductor cage, waist core, and both grounded feet centered inside the frame.
storm_voltaic_sentinel.background: A warm pale-coral sky over an ochre rooftop, creating strong separation around the dark plated guardian and bright electrical channels.
storm_voltaic_sentinel.notes: Bulwark is grounded containment, not a shield bubble. No humanoid knight, weapon, giant robot, lightning attack, cloud body, extra sentinels, or copied Spring Coil shape.

storm_thunderstrike.subject: A dense gold-white thunder ring collapses around one cyan vertical bolt at the instant it strikes a single iron capstone, kicking out three short storm-silver pressure arcs and a tight halo of charcoal dust. The impact remains compact and geometrically clear.
storm_thunderstrike.perspective: Low close three-quarter view with the capstone, complete vertical bolt, collapsing ring, and three pressure arcs centered.
storm_thunderstrike.background: A warm burnt-orange cliff face under dusty amber light, opposing the cold bright electrical impact.
storm_thunderstrike.notes: One strike on one object. No caster, enemy figure, battlefield destruction, branching chain targets, giant explosion, storm panorama, or text-like symbol.

storm_stormcallers_pact.subject: Three different storm-silver conductor staffs lean inward until their tips form a stable triangle, holding one hovering charcoal cloud core while separate cyan currents join into a gold-white thunder ring around it. Only three cropped gloved hands steady the shafts at the lower edge.
storm_stormcallers_pact.perspective: Low upward three-quarter close view centered on the triangular staff tips, cloud core, joined currents, and complete thunder ring.
storm_stormcallers_pact.background: A warm coral-and-amber twilight sky with thin ochre cloud, providing maximum contrast behind the cool apparatus and black core.
storm_stormcallers_pact.notes: No readable oath, full casters, lightning storm, giant portal, tornado, flags, creature face in the cloud, or overlapping extra staffs.

storm_vael_the_stormbringer.subject: Vael is a powerful humanoid elemental formed from a compact charcoal thunderhead wrapped in layered storm-silver armor ribbons, lunging forward with two distinct gold-white arm arcs that strike on opposite sides of one centered cyan core. Below the calm mask-like face, two tiny ochre-clad watchkeepers recoil behind a broken parapet as the dark elemental bears down on them.
storm_vael_the_stormbringer.perspective: Low dynamic medium-full three-quarter view with Vael's face, cyan core, complete lunging torso, and both separated arm arcs inside the middle 70%.
storm_vael_the_stormbringer.background: A warm ember-orange sky above a pale ochre plateau, silhouetting the dark elemental while preserving the two bright strike paths.
storm_vael_the_stormbringer.notes: Doublestrike is two arm arcs in one action. Keep the two frightened watchkeepers tiny and subordinate to Vael. No giant titan scale, weapon, crown, wings, army, full tornado body, or duplicate of Zael's upright storm-lord pose.
